XXProject Overview§1.1 · What SP6500 actually is
§1.1 — the precise cut

A single-channel IV pump.
Not multi-channel. Not a syringe pump.
Not closed-loop.

Dose-error reduction, yes. But the prescriber stays in the loop — clinicians authorize each dose, the pump enforces the boundary. The "closed-loop" in marketing copy is the internal flow-rate controller, nothing more.
